text: UBS posts $1.2B Q4 net profit (+56% YoY), in line revenues of $12.1B, and announces at least $3B in 2026 share buybacks alongside a higher dividend. CET1 slips to 14.4% as invested assets exceed $7T for the first time. Net new assets slow to $8.5B from $37.5B prior quarter, with $14B outflows from the U.S., even as Europe/Asia inflows offset weakness.

meta.note: Tension between buybacks and looming Swiss capital requirements.

text: Novo Nordisk's Copenhagen shares drop about 17% after management pre-releases 2026 guidance showing sales and operating profit down 5-13% at constant FX. The selloff reflects sharply lower U.S. pricing for Wegovy, rising competition (including compounding pharmacies and Eli Lilly), and loss of exclusivity in several ex-U.S. markets, even as early uptake of the oral Wegovy pill is unusually strong (≈170,000 patients after four weeks).

meta.note: Opposing signals between pill demand strength and core revenue erosion created schema tension.
